body.name: Envelope-weighted weak model-index topology \(\mathcal T_{\mathcal E}\)
body.construction: On primitive-row laws, take the initial topology generated by the maps \(P\mapsto P[f]\) for every bounded continuous test function and the moment map \(P\mapsto P[\mathcal E_T^{2+\delta_{\mathrm{mom}}}]\). Thus convergence is ordinary weak convergence plus convergence of the common envelope moment. Equip \(\vartheta_Q=(\beta_{0,Q},\sigma_Q^2,\tau_Q^2,p_{0:T-1,Q})\) with its Euclidean topology. Their product is \(\mathcal T_{\mathcal E}\).
